scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakar Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhatravriti Yojana
other_conditions: Parent must be a registered unorganized worker in the Social Security Board
Scholarship is limited to the first two sons or daughters of a registered unorganized worker
Contract workers, domestic female workers, porters, and sanitation workers are explicitly excluded
Students must complete at least one year of engineering or medical education; dropping out within a year requires returning the scholarship money
Each student can receive only one scholarship, even if eligible for multiple
benefits_summary: Provides educational financial assistance ranging from ₹500 for primary classes up to ₹5,000 for postgraduate and professional courses to eligible children of registered unorganized workers.
